# Expiring relationships. A relationship stops granting at the first
# revision committed at or after its expiry, and every snapshot keeps what
# it saw. "at" moves the clock; each write is a revision of its own.

schema
  caveat flag(on bool) { on }
  
  definition user {}
  
  definition group {
    relation member: user | user with flag | group#member
  }
  
  definition folder {
    relation viewer: user | group#member
    permission view = viewer
  }
  
  definition doc {
    relation parent: folder
    relation viewer: user | user with flag | user:* | group#member
    relation banned: user
    permission view = (viewer + parent->view) - banned
  }

case visible until the revision whose commit time reaches the expiry
write doc:d#viewer@user:a expires 10s
mark t0
check doc:d#view@user:a => allowed
at 9.999999999s
write doc:noise#viewer@user:z
mark t1
check doc:d#view@user:a => allowed
at 10s
write doc:noise#viewer@user:y
mark t2
check doc:d#view@user:a => denied
check @t0 doc:d#view@user:a => allowed
check @t1 doc:d#view@user:a => allowed
check @t2 doc:d#view@user:a => denied
resources @t1 doc#view@user:a => d
resources @t2 doc#view@user:a => -
subjects @t1 doc:d#view@user => a
subjects @t2 doc:d#view@user => -

case time passing without a write changes nothing
write doc:d#viewer@user:a expires 10s
at 1h
check doc:d#view@user:a => allowed
write doc:noise#viewer@user:z
check doc:d#view@user:a => denied

case written already expired
at 20s
write doc:d#viewer@user:a expires 20s
write doc:d#viewer@user:b expires 5s
write doc:d#viewer@user:c expires 20.000000001s
check doc:d#view@user:a => denied
check doc:d#view@user:b => denied
check doc:d#view@user:c => allowed

case touching again moves the expiry, and old snapshots keep the old one
write doc:d#viewer@user:a expires 10s
mark short
at 5s
write doc:d#viewer@user:a expires 1h
mark long
at 30s
write doc:noise#viewer@user:z
check doc:d#view@user:a => allowed
check @short doc:d#view@user:a => allowed
at 2h
write doc:d#viewer@user:a
check doc:d#view@user:a => allowed
check @long doc:d#view@user:a => allowed

case recreated after it expired
write doc:d#viewer@user:a expires 1s
at 2s
write doc:noise#viewer@user:z
check doc:d#view@user:a => denied
# Deleting an expired relationship changes nothing.
delete doc:d#viewer@user:a
write doc:d#viewer@user:a
check doc:d#view@user:a => allowed

case an expiring membership in a group and an arrow
write group:g#member@user:a expires 10s
write folder:f#viewer@group:g#member
write doc:d#parent@folder:f expires 20s
write doc:e#viewer@group:g#member
check doc:d#view@user:a => allowed
check doc:e#view@user:a => allowed
at 10s
write doc:noise#viewer@user:z
check doc:d#view@user:a => denied
check doc:e#view@user:a => denied
check group:g#member@user:a => denied
check doc:d#view@group:g#member => allowed
at 20s
write doc:noise#viewer@user:y
check doc:d#view@group:g#member => denied
resources doc#view@group:g#member => e

case an expiring ban gives access back
write doc:d#viewer@user:*
write doc:d#banned@user:a expires 10s
check doc:d#view@user:a => denied
subjects doc:d#view@user => *-a
at 10s
write doc:noise#viewer@user:z
check doc:d#view@user:a => allowed
subjects doc:d#view@user => *

case a caveat with an expiry
write doc:d#viewer@user:a with flag expires 10s
check doc:d#view@user:a {"on":true} => allowed
check doc:d#view@user:a => conditional[on]
at 10s
write doc:noise#viewer@user:z
check doc:d#view@user:a {"on":true} => denied
check doc:d#view@user:a => denied

case an expiring plain grant next to a lasting caveated one
write group:g#member@user:a expires 10s
write doc:d#viewer@group:g#member
write doc:d#viewer@user:a with flag
check doc:d#view@user:a => allowed
at 10s
write doc:noise#viewer@user:z
check doc:d#view@user:a => conditional[on]
check doc:d#view@user:a {"on":true} => allowed

case touching a relationship with a caveat replaces its expiry too
write group:g#member@user:a expires 10s
write group:g#member@user:a with flag
at 10s
write doc:noise#viewer@user:z
check group:g#member@user:a => conditional[on]
